data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that provides left-scroll action buttons like WeChat.
data.what_it_does: Allows users to slide list items to the left to reveal hidden buttons such as edit or delete. Supports grouped close tags so that opening one item automatically closes others.
use_when: You want a WeChat-style swipe-to-reveal action menu for list items.
You need linked closing behavior where opening one row closes others with the same tag.
avoid_when: You need complex swipe gestures beyond standard left-scroll action buttons.
strengths: Provides WeChat-style list item swipe actions and iOS bounce effects out of the box.
Supports tag-based synchronization to auto-close other rows.
